title: Girls’ Frontline
description: Dolls’ FrontlineIn the fallout of nuclear war, the last of humanity survives with the help of life-like androids known as Dolls. Built to serve, some fight in wars as Tactical Dolls or T-Dolls. Now, an elite team comprised of T-Dolls are sent to face a new rogue threat, Sangvis Ferri. Leading them into battle is their new human commander, M4A1.

episodes_data.title: Girls’ Frontline Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: AR Team is trapped in enemy territory, and must break an encirclement to deliver valuable data back to base. But the enemy numbers are vast, and there's only a few of them…

episodes_data.title: Girls’ Frontline Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: A new commander arrives at the forward base, and is quickly sent into battle. But a high-priority mission comes in before she even has a chance to get her feet wet.

episodes_data.title: Girls’ Frontline Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: M4A1 is trapped behind enemy lines with a deadly Sangvis Executioner after her. But even with Griffin T-Doll teams nearby, she's still reluctant to turn to them for help...

episodes_data.title: Girls’ Frontline Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: The mission to recover the other missing members of AR Team begins. They recover SOPII, but she quickly clashes with her new commander.

episodes_data.title: Girls’ Frontline Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: A tense standoff during the attempt to rescue AR15 is interrupted when the Sangvis troops go out of control and start shooting each other.

episodes_data.title: Girls’ Frontline Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: M4A1 continues her search for M16. But the members of 404 are after her as well, and they don't have good intentions…

episodes_data.title: Girls’ Frontline Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: AR Team tracks down Intruder, the Sangvis T-Doll commander. But Intruder is a commander-type, and has more than a few tricks up her sleeve…

episodes_data.title: Girls’ Frontline Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Griffin's commanders are summoned to an emergency meeting at a secret HQ after the discovery of a piece of secret Sangvis data.

episodes_data.title: Girls’ Frontline Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: AR Team goes on the hunt for Destroyer, the Ringleader behind the attack on the secret HQ. But something's wrong with AR15…

episodes_data.title: Girls’ Frontline Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: AR15 is now a fugitive, hunted by both Griffin and Sangvis. The rest of AR Team wants to hunt for her, but Griffin has other plans for them.

episodes_data.title: Girls’ Frontline Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Squad Negev is assigned to help find the missing AR15. But they're cut off by Sangvis and trapped.

episodes_data.title: Girls’ Frontline Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: As the Sangvis Mastermind throws hordes of T-Dolls at Griffin in an attempt to capture M4A1, AR15 prepares herself to make one last sacrifice for her friends.
